notes.title: Mathbits v1.1 (July 2025)
notes.content: [h3]Improvements & Fixes[/h3][list][*][p]Matrixbit UX: You can now press [b]Enter to rewrite your answer[/b] quickly.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where "Enter to rewrite answer" would flash unnecessarily after correcting a wrong answer.[/p][/*][*][p]Critical bug fix: Leaderboards now update and display correctly in all game modes. (If your leaderboard score was incorrectly updated for a mode, play the mode for 2 rounds and your highest score should upload correctly)[/p][/*][*][p]Clarified that [b]"Rank" = Global Rank[/b] in all leaderboard screens.[/p][/*][/list][h3]New Features[/h3][list][*][p]Matrix Square Mode: New challenge mode added to Matrixbit.[/p][/*][*][p]When ending a Matrixbit game, your last submitted answer is now shown.[/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: First Patch Release! (July 2025)
notes.content: [p]Hi! Thanks to those who bought and tried the game right on release day. Here's the first set of patches:  [/p][p][/p][list][*][p]Removed the initial flash of graphs in Graphbit[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed the correct answer display inside Solvebit modes (e.g. Time mode) [/p][/*][*][p]Invert "Find trigonometry functions" with "Find quadratic functions" inside Graphbit[/p][/*][*][p]Fix LSD Cats & Secret Number achievement inside game[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p]I expect to push 1-2 updates each month starting from now, so feel free to leave your suggestions below![/p]
